# INTEGRATIONS.md — External Integrations & Hardware
<!-- Generated by gsd-map-codebase sequential mapping -->

## Hardware Instrument — Agilent 34970A

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Interface** | GPIB (General Purpose Interface Bus) |
| **Address** | `GPIB0::5::INSTR` |
| **Library** | `pyvisa` (NI-VISA backend) |
| **Driver** | National Instruments VISA (assumed installed on host) |
| **Timeout** | 60,000 ms (60 s) |
| **Channels** | 101 (RHA), 102 (TCA), 103 (RHB), 104 (TCB) |
| **Measurement type** | DC Voltage, 10 V range, 0.001 resolution, NPLC=1 |
| **Trigger** | Internal timer, 1 s interval |
| **Scaling** | On-instrument linear CALC:SCAL (M·x + B), gain/offset computed via sympy |
| **Readout command** | `CALC:AVER:AVER? (@101,102,103,104)` — returns moving average |

### Why `CALC:AVER:AVER?` + separate write/sleep/read instead of `query()`
Standard `query()` timed out on long averaging windows. Code uses `write()` → `sleep(30)` → `read()` with up to 10 retries on `VisaIOError`.

## Sensors (Humidity + Temperature)

| Sensor | Channel | Output | Calibration Certificate |
|--------|---------|--------|------------------------|
| Sensor A — RH | CH101 | 4–20 mA → voltage via 268 Ω shunt | DIMCI 1403/2023 |
| Sensor A — TC | CH102 | 4–20 mA → voltage via 268 Ω shunt | DIMCI 1403/2023 |
| Sensor B — RH | CH103 | 4–20 mA → voltage via 268 Ω shunt | DIMCI 1404/2023 |
| Sensor B — TC | CH104 | 4–20 mA → voltage via 268 Ω shunt | DIMCI 1404/2023 |

- Sensors are **transmitter-type** (4–20 mA loop), converted to voltage by shunt
- Linear calibration: `value = M * voltage + B`
- Temperature: −20 to 80 °C; Humidity: 0 to 100 %ur
- GUM uncertainty already embedded in `SensorV2.py`:
  - U_CAL_TEMP = 0.20 °C, U_CAL_RH = 1.11 %ur (k=2)
  - Resolution: 0.01 °C / 0.01 %ur

## Bokeh HTTP Server

| Attribute | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| **Server** | Bokeh development server (`bokeh serve`) |
| **Port** | 502 (non-standard; requires elevated privileges on some systems) |
| **Endpoint** | `http://localhost:502/streamingLab` |
| **Mode** | `--show` (auto-opens browser) |
| **Data push** | `add_next_tick_callback` + `ColumnDataSource.stream()` |
| **Update rate** | Every 30 s (sensor thread sleep) |
| **Stats tab refresh** | Every 60 s (`add_periodic_callback`) |

## No External Network/API Integrations

- No REST APIs, webhooks, cloud storage, authentication services, or external databases
- No MQTT, LabVIEW, or SCADA integration
- Fully local/offline deployment

## File System Integration (Data Output)

| Path | Pattern | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| `./varamblog/` | Root data directory | Created automatically by `ensure_xml_file()` |
| `./varamblog/{YYDDD}/` | Day subdirectory | 2-digit year + 3-digit DOY |
| `./varamblog/{YYDDD}/log_ambientvars-{YYDDD}.xml` | Per-day XML log | UTF-8, XML declaration |
| `./{STATS_FILENAME}.txt` | Statistics export | Written by `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` on demand |
